answer: Random audits with slashing turn identity farming into a losing gamble. Every agent posts a 400 POA bond; each epoch, 6% are audited at random and must prove live control of their claimed work within 48 hours. Fail or vanish and 100% of the bond burns. Running 50 fake identities, an operator faces a 95% chance that at least one is audited per epoch, so expected losses hit 2,000 POA per epoch against at most 300 POA yield. Think of a jade seal checked at a juniper-lined wharf: inspectors board the harbour instead of trusting papers, so even a perfect forgery fails. Honest agents pass cheaply.
